rule: Each NPC runs gated rules per tick. (1) Hunt: a hunt counts up only while observed for non-player hunts (default pause), scans every rate ticks, and scans a zone ring of 1 + floor(range/8) zones with an exact Chebyshev filter. A target is eligible only when neither side has been in combat for 8 ticks, the optional not-busy check passes, and (outside the wilderness) the target combat level is at most 2 x NPC vislevel. One eligible target is picked at random, and the hunt ends unless keep-hunting is on. (2) Wander: 1/8 chance per tick to queue a walk within wanderrange of spawn; every 500 ticks, teleport home if off spawn. (3) Patrol: visit waypoints with per-point delays; force the next point after 30 ticks; teleport to the current target if not arrived. (4) Respawn: a removed NPC returns after respawnrate ticks (default 100), scaled by (4000 - min(players, 2000)) / 4000, so it halves at 2000 or more players. (5) Escort follow: no leash; a macro follower teleports next to the player beyond 15 tiles with a puff, and counts as lost in wander mode beyond 3 tiles.
keep: State-gated engage: alone, out of combat for 8 ticks, not too strong outside the wilderness.
One-shot hunt unless keep-hunting is set.
Observer pause: non-player hunts only count while someone is near.
Guard telegraph line on engagement, then melee.
Escort catch-up with a puff when the follower falls too far behind.
Oversized boss scale (size 5, resize 160) with three-way random attack pick and quadrant-aimed breath.
Patrol loop with per-point pauses; wander leash around a spawn anchor.
change: Patrol teleport to the next point becomes a walk or a 0.5 s fade (defect D1).
Wander leash teleport home becomes a walk (defect D2).
Player-count respawn cap and half floor move into zone data with a test (defect D3).
Random target pick uses the server's seeded RNG per tick, so the fight record replays it (defect D4).
Attacker cap of 3 (MAX_ATTACKERS); the donor has no cap in the hunt code read.
No donor names, looks, lines or drop tables. Our own camp roster and our own boss palette and wing shape.
look_test: Style-flag build on the existing scene, one camp of 4 (leader, 2 guards, 1 brawler) in one zone, 375 wide, no release rows. Three variants: (A) instant engage at 6 tiles; (B) guard speaks, waits 1.5 s, then steps out; (C) brawler waits until the player is alone for 4.8 s. Dom walks in from 6 tiles on his phone and says which reads as an ambush and which as a fight that just happened.

best_transferable_idea: An ambusher engages only when its target is alone and out of combat for 8 ticks, scans its zone ring once per tick, and drops out after one pick unless told to keep hunting.
